description: Create an alert rule. It always starts in test mode: it alerts, but nothing blocks, rate-limits or acts on its alerts until a person promotes it. Instant rule: executionMode "instant" plus instant {matchMode: any|all, conditions: [{field: path|method|user_agent|status_code|request_body|request_headers|client_ip|host, operator, value}]}. Periodic rule: sqlQuery plus schedule {cronExpression}; the SQL must scope every table with the __USER_APP_KEYS__ placeholder, bound time on every table read, and return a column named ip (the API refuses SQL with no ip column, since it would never alert, unless allowNoIp). A periodic rule runs once right away (firstRunQueued); see securenow_alert_rule_runs. Easiest path: securenow_alert_rule_draft, then pass its draft fields here. Write action; requires confirmation.

allowNoIp.description: Periodic rules: save SQL that returns no ip column anyway (it will never notify). Default false.

applicationsAll.description: true watches every app instead of applications.

category.description: One word, e.g. authentication, scanning, exfiltration.

confirm.description: Required for write actions. Must be true.

description.description: What it catches, in a sentence.

executionMode.description: scheduled (periodic SQL, the default) or instant (conditions on every request).

instant.description: Instant rules: {matchMode: "any" | "all", conditions: [{field, operator, value}], environments: ["staging"] (optional; omit to watch every environment)}.

nlpQuery.description: The detection idea in plain English (kept with the rule).

reason.description: Short human-readable reason for the write action.

schedule.description: Periodic rules: {cronExpression: "* * * * *", description: "Every minute"}. Default every 15 minutes.

throttle.description: Optional {enabled: true, minutes: 15}: one alert per address every N minutes (other addresses still alert).

name: securenow_alert_rule_create
title: Create Alert Rule (Test Mode)
